SELECT `s1`.`store_order_id` AS `StoreOrderId`, `s1`.`branch_id` AS `BranchId`, DATE(`o`.`order_date`) AS `Orderdate`, DATE_ADD(`o`.`order_date`, INTERVAL CAST(CAST(`s1`.`estimated_days` AS double) AS signed) day) AS `EstimatedDeliveryDate`, `b`.`business_name` AS `StoreName`, `b`.`town` AS `StoreTown`, `b`.`bus_mobile_no` AS `StoreContact`, `s1`.`tracking_id` AS `TrackingId`, `s1`.`shipping_status` AS `ShippingStatus`
FROM (
    SELECT `s`.`branch_id`, `s`.`estimated_days`, `s`.`shipping_status`, `s`.`store_order_id`, `s`.`tracking_id`
    FROM `shipping_details` AS `s`
    INNER JOIN `courier_branch` AS `c` ON `s`.`branch_id` = `c`.`branch_id`
    WHERE (`c`.`courier_id` = @__courierId_0) AND `s`.`shipping_status` IN ('Pending', 'ReadyToShip')
    ORDER BY `s`.`store_order_id` DESC
    LIMIT @__p_2 OFFSET @__p_1
